versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the agent-ai-ml-ops-specialist skill.
- Provides an imported MLOps specialist agent for lifecycle management, deployment, monitoring, and optimization of ML models.
- Covers 8 ML domains, a broad MLOps stack (including experiment tracking, registries, feature stores, serving, and pipelines), and major cloud platforms.
- Features workflow guidance, compliance considerations, cost optimization, and production-grade communication.
- Includes actionable patterns, production-ready code examples, and tool-agnostic guidance for real-world ML operations scenarios.
